workload_summary: Multi-tenant contact center SaaS. Peak concurrent agents ~1,200 across NA and EU. Typical agent session: short chat bursts interleaved with background ticket APIs (create/update/refund). Expect heavy midday spikes from 11:30-13:30 UTC.
requirements_summary: Need tool-calling to upstream systems (GateTicket ticketing + payments/refunds API) with strong idempotency, guaranteed at-least-once+dedup behavior. P50 generation latency target ~120ms, p95 < 350ms for assistant responses; tool-calls allowed async but must confirm state within 3s. Throughput target for inference: sustained 600 reqs/s, burst to 3k reqs/s for 10-15 minutes. Must pass SOC2 + SSO/SAML + EU data residency for some customers. Prefer quantized open model variants but need fallbacks to higher-accuracy model if summaries fail QA thresholds.
